cpu_cores.description: CPU cores for the notebook's sandbox kernel; must be a supported option.

idle_timeout_seconds.description: Maximum lifetime of the sandbox kernel in seconds. It shuts down this long after it starts, even while in use. A running kernel keeps its current lifetime until it restarts.

memory_gb.description: Memory in GB for the notebook's sandbox kernel; must be a supported option.

short_id.description: The notebook's short_id, the short alphanumeric id in its URL (e.g. `aBcD1234`) that `notebooks-list` returns; not the notebook's UUID `id`.
